overall: MARGINAL overall: calm on the Coron side and in the south, POOR in the west and at Linapacan through Thursday midday
limiterDetail: The main limiter is wind: east to northeast 17–19 kt now at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan (gusts 24–25), 15 kt at Linapacan, 14 kt at Alava and Binudac, 9 kt on the Coron side, and only 2–6 kt at Tara, Decabobo, Turda, Maglalambay and Panlaitan. Current is the second factor at the evening pickup in the south (Turda and Tara 1.2–1.3 kt). Rain is light until Thursday morning, when the west gets showers about 3 AM–2 PM (up to 1.4 mm/h at Cabunlawan and Decabaitot around noon). 24h totals are 0–8.5 mm; Tara, Decabobo and Turda stay dry.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: no gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning for Calamian / MIMAROPA. The feed still references the Tropical Cyclone Alert for Typhoon Rosal (Champi) , not covering Palawan. The latest items (to Mon 26 Oct 5:26 AM PHT) are final general flood advisories for the Visayas regions, none covering Palawan.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: The west-side wind now lasts through Thursday morning instead of easing at dawn. Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan hold 16–20 kt (gusts to 25) until about 1 PM Thursday, and Linapacan stays at 13–15 kt. Thursday morning also turns wetter in the west, with showers about 3 AM–2 PM (7–8.5 mm at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Barangonan and Linapacan). The regional Thursday forecast is back to 14 kt, gusts 20 (this morning it was 9.8 kt, gusts 15).

That costs the west a second morning, so Friday 30 arrivals slip back to SOFT (was slightly soft). Thursday stays SOFT. The grounds now read 5 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 6 POOR / 0 VERY POOR (was 7 / 7 / 2 / 0 at 6 AM). Saturday's rain rose to 8.9 mm (was 5.1) but wind stays light (5.3 kt). PAGASA has nothing for Palawan.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF (unchanged). Shortage risk stays ELEVATED on the dashboard's detector for Wed–Mon (guide only). The tightest arrivals are now Thursday 29 and Friday 30. Buy what you need from today's landings and lean on the Coron side, Panlaitan, Maglalambay, Galoc, Decabobo, Tara and Turda for Thursday and Friday.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight about 11 PM to 6 AM Thursday on the Coron side and in the south; also this afternoon on sheltered grounds
details: 11 PM–6 AM tonight: Coron, Tara, Turda, Decabobo, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan 0.0–0.4 kt, wind 2–6 kt, dry. The dashboard's lowest combined score is Decabobo about midnight.
